dataset_title: Bottle-level calculated biochemical methane potential from a global interlaboratory study
source_location: Repository data/BMP_calc.csv; repository README column definition for bmp_calc; article data-processing methods and results
license: CC BY 4.0 as specified by the public data repository LICENSE; attribution to Hafner et al. (2026) and the repository is retained.
geography: International interlaboratory study: 31 laboratories from 17 countries; laboratory identities are anonymized.
experimental_context: Author-calculated bottle-level BMP records from two interlaboratory test rounds; six reference substrates occur across the rounds. The paper reports interlaboratory reproducibility and measurement-quality findings.
data_handling: Copied the 619 data rows and eight original column names from BMP_calc.csv without filtering, unit conversion, or recalculation. bmp_calc is calculated by the study authors from submitted detailed methane measurements and is expressed as mL CH4 per g substrate VS added. bottle_id is unique in this extract.
unit: mL CH4 g^-1 substrate VS added
basis: Author-calculated bottle-level BMP, normalized to volatile solids of substrate added; not a continuous-process or wet-feed yield.
measurement_basis: One bottle-level calculated BMP result per row. The original data repository also supplies setup and biogas time-series files; those files are not copied here.
uncertainty: The selected BMP_calc.csv has no uncertainty column. Between-bottle and between-laboratory variation is retained as separate records, but pooled spread must not be interpreted as intrinsic substrate uncertainty or full-scale process uncertainty.
applicability: Phase 5 method-validation comparator for BMP calculation, assay reproducibility, and cross-laboratory quality checks. Technology-specific measurement evidence that may inform other biorefinery project data-quality workflows; it does not supply substrate-specific design yields.
conversion_and_scaling: No numeric conversion or scaling applied; source file columns and values were preserved. Not scaled to continuous digesters.
limitations: The selected file contains author-calculated BMP values, not raw cumulative-gas records or the laboratories' separately submitted BMP values.
The six study substrates are reference assay materials and do not include GreenHub roadside grass or route-specific residual streams.
A BMP assay is not a continuous digester; the dataset does not establish full-scale methane yield, loading, retention time, inhibition, or energy demand.
Do not filter reported outliers or use the pooled bottle range as a default performance distribution without a separate, validated analysis.
